evidence: acc03_tests pass_latches builds a hierarchical manifest, refuses a fifth child, a node past the depth cap, a metadata overrun, and an int64 length sum, and shows the root digest change with the leaf.
acc03_tests pass_latches streams an encoded checkpoint in windows of at most 32 bytes, resumes after the first window, refuses a larger chunk, and matches the joined bytes to the artifact.
acc03_tests pass_latches seals a generation by rename, refuses a symlink, refuses a different replacement, keeps a leased file, detects a later byte change, and refuses a body above 4096 bytes.
A real runtime load of a verified checkpoint from a second source is not performed. Acc03 returns UNQUALIFIED and pass_latches checks that refusal.
acc03_tests pass_latches accepts only a full identity match. The same family and shape with a missing tokenizer or a different precision is SHAPE. A quantized derivative is DERIVATIVE.
acc03_tests pass_latches edits one token and invalidates only that page and its suffix, then an append leaves the earlier page valid.
acc03_tests pass_latches refuses metadata-only placement and copies the numeric tensor values into the destination.
acc03_tests pass_latches accepts a checkpoint only through IntegerTrainer::CheckState. A hash-only accept is SHORTCUT. A changed weight that keeps the old hash is refused.
acc03_tests pass_latches keeps an active page, caps speculative pages at two, revokes one speculative page, and refuses to revoke the active page.
acc03_tests pass_latches computes resident, moving, and recompute costs and selects the minimum. A smaller recompute input changes the selection.
acc03_tests pass_latches runs the dense owner, adds both consumer gradients, matches their sum to the analytic gradient, and steps only after both consumers have contributed.
acc03_tests pass_latches saves weights, both moment vectors, step, rng, cursor, recipe, topology, and epoch through the checkpoint closure and restores them. A weights-only save stays partial.
acc03_tests pass_latches accepts one update under the influence cap, then refuses a duplicate interval, a different base, and a share above the cap.
acc03_tests pass_latches keeps the rights string and policy version when the body changes, and refuses a rights change or a policy-version change.
acc03_tests pass_latches steps a student weight from the teacher residual so squared loss falls from 20 to 5, refuses an unevaluated merge, and records the evaluated midpoint.
acc03_tests pass_latches leaves the objective on hold when the claimed digest does not match, then sets it from the observation after the digest is recomputed.
acc03_tests pass_latches keeps the specialist when a worse occupant arrives, and keeps the exploration id when an exploit candidate tries to take that slot.
acc03_tests pass_latches records an even 5/5 baseline and a gain-weighted 7/3 split of the same budget of 10.
acc03_tests pass_latches clips held-out demands to a fixed cap in shadow and leaves the production counter at 0. release_qualified stays false.
acc03_tests pass_latches refuses a score before the plan digest exists, then scores the held-out pair as 3 and refuses a different plan.
acc03_tests pass_latches keeps the width for a repeated sample and for a second sample on the same task, and narrows it only for a new task.
acc03_tests pass_latches leaves fitness unchanged for the proposer's validation and for a wrong recompute, then sets it from an independent recompute of 2+2.
acc03_tests pass_latches refuses adoption before promotion, and promotion alone leaves adoption empty. release_qualified stays false.
acc03_tests pass_latches runs a second integer step that changes the weight and momentum. A cycle that does not step is WORK and leaves the first weight.
